name: Jev 1.14

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: TypeSafe charges input tokens only ($42 per billion), the same as for jev-1.13.0; output tokens are free; the long-context option costs the same per token; no cache price, batch price or per-question fee is published

benchmarks.name: TypeSafe internal intelligence measure (chart in the Jev 1.14 release post; higher is better)
benchmarks.setting: jev-1.14.0; jev-1.13.0 scored 58.9 on the same chart; the chart carries a warning not to trust benchmarks
benchmarks.harness: TypeSafe's own unpublished measure, compared only with models the post calls open-weight; the post calls it a best guess likely biased towards its own models

benchmarks.name: TypeSafe internal calibration error (chart in the Jev 1.14 release post; lower is better)
benchmarks.setting: jev-1.14.0; jev-1.13.0 scored 1.8 on the same chart; units not stated
benchmarks.harness: TypeSafe's own unpublished measure, as above

unknown: context_window: TypeSafe gives 64k tokens per request and 32k per question by default, and 262k for both with the opt-in long-context header, with no exact token count [ts-models]
max_output: does not apply; Jev returns typed answers (a choice, a probability, a score or a box), not generated tokens
benchmarks: no independent score for jev-1.14.0 was found; the JevBench page could not be read on 2026-10-27 because it exceeded the fetch size limit
SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): does not apply; Jev cannot write code or text
Terminal-Bench 4.0: does not apply; Jev cannot run an agent loop that produces commands
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: does not apply; the index measures generative models
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: does not apply; Jev cannot act as a coding agent
METR 50% time horizon: does not apply; Jev cannot carry out a multi-step task
system_card: TypeSafe publishes no system or model card, and its docs index of 2026-10-27 lists a weakness page for jev-1.13 only [ts-llms]
access: search results list an OpenRouter page for jev-1.14, but the two OpenRouter addresses tried returned 404 on 2026-10-28, so OpenRouter is not recorded
modalities: image input is a preview behind the TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images header and is not called ready for production [ts-images]; the System One concept page still says text only [ts-system-one]

status: the release arrived as jev-preview, and the post announced that jev-latest would follow a week later [ts-jev114]; on 2026-10-27 the Models page showed both aliases on jev-1.14.0 and called jev-latest the most recent stable official release [ts-models], but TypeSafe has not said that the early access of the class has ended; recorded as preview
